parts.name: head
parts.prompt: Production game asset for a 2D cut-out puppet. Character: Brenna, from reference image 1 (our original concept sheet); match her colours, materials and painting style exactly. Hand-painted storybook cartoon, soft painterly brush texture, thin dark warm outline, light from the top-left. Side view facing right. Draw ONLY the single body part described, isolated, centred, on a fully transparent background. No shadow on the ground, no text, no other body parts, no frame. Reference image 2 is a technical silhouette/canvas guide ONLY: use its orientation, proportions and marked joint location; do NOT reproduce its checkerboard, magenta cross, placeholder colors or low-detail drawing. The joint end must be rounded and overlap about 10 percent beyond the joint. Keep fine Celtic trim away from moving seam ends. This image will be rotated in a puppet, so no perspective foreshortening. Brenna's head in strict RIGHT SIDE PROFILE: one visible eye, freckles, determined friendly expression, ear, loose wavy red hair; NO braid, NO collar, NO torso. Short rounded neck stub at the bottom tucked under the head, joint at normalized bottom-left (0.42,0.06). Hair #C8452C with warm copper highlights. Match the side-profile face in the concept. Portrait canvas 288x320; head almost fills width and height; neck stub reaches near bottom.
parts.exportOperation: Trim generated alpha fringe; resample into the 4x template occupied bounds; preserve alpha. Source preserved.

iterations.name: torso
iterations.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference image 1 is our generated Brenna torso EDIT TARGET. Reference image 2 is our own approved Brenna design. Reference image 3 is the technical torso template. Change the torso's proportions and waist boundary to fit the template. Preserve olive-green woven wool, gold knot collar, brown strap and round gold knot buckle. Make a compact broad chest from rounded shoulder cap at top to BELT AT THE VERY BOTTOM, with only a tiny rounded 5% overlap below the belt. REMOVE the long tunic section below the belt completely. Move the small stone pouch UP so it sits entirely over the lower chest and belt at the left hip, not hanging beneath the waist. The belt center must be at normalized image height 0.10 from the bottom; waist joint at (0.50,0.06). Broad portrait224x240 silhouette (almost as wide as tall), facing right. No arms, head, skirt, legs, checkerboard, magenta marker, frame, ground shadow or text. Fully transparent background. Smoothly rounded top shoulders and softly rounded waist overlap suitable for a cut-out puppet.
